question: restaurants inside buildings
sql: SELECT p.id, p.names."primary" AS name, p.basic_category, p.addresses[1].locality AS locality FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' LIMIT 20;

question: buildings containing wellness service POIs
sql: SELECT b.id, b.names."primary" AS name, b.subtype, b.class, b.height FROM lisbon_buildings b WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lisbon_places p WHERE p.basic_category = 'wellness_service' AND ST_Contains(b.geometry, p.geometry)) LIMIT 20;

question: buildings that touch another building
sql: SELECT b1.id AS building_id, b2.id AS touching_building_id, b1.subtype, b2.subtype FROM lisbon_buildings b1 JOIN lisbon_buildings b2 ON ST_Touches(b1.geometry, b2.geometry) WHERE b1.id < b2.id LIMIT 20;

question: restaurants in central Lisbon bbox
sql: SELECT p.id, p.names."primary" AS name, p.basic_category, p.addresses[1].freeform AS address FROM lisbon_places p WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.20, 38.70, -9.10, 38.76)) LIMIT 20;

question: buildings with the most POIs inside
sql: SELECT b.id, b.subtype, b.class, COUNT(*) AS num_pois FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Contains(b.geometry, p.geometry) GROUP BY b.id, b.subtype, b.class ORDER BY num_pois DESC LIMIT 20;

question: POIs outside building footprints
sql: SELECT p.id, p.names."primary" AS name, p.basic_category FROM lisbon_places p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lisbon_buildings b WHERE ST_Intersects(p.geometry, b.geometry)) LIMIT 20;
